newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA'S ZEMAN RETURNS FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA'S ZEMAN RETURNS FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Midfielder Marian Zeman has been recalled to the Slovakian squad to play Malta in a World Cup qualifier on Monday.
Slovakia, placed third in group six behind Spain and Yugoslavia, named the Istanbulspor player in a 20-man squad after he was sidelined for several weeks due to injury.
Slovakia won their opening three matches, including a 6-0 home victory against Malta, but crashed 4-1 to Spain in their last match.
Earlier this month they beat Bulgaria 1-0 in a friendly.
Defenders - Dusan Tittel, Ivan Kozak, Marek Spilar, Miroslav Karhan, Peter Dzurik, Stanislav Varga
Midfielders - Julius Simon, Lubomir Moravcik, Igor Demo, Stefan Majoros, Miroslav Sovic, Vladislav Zvara, Marian Zeman
Strikers - Samuel Slovak, Tibor Jancula, Szilard Nemeth, Igor Balis, Robert Semenik.
